typography.instructions: Import Google font 'Noto Sans Georgian' in the index.html or index.css (e.g., @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Noto+Sans+Georgian:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap');). Do not use 'Inter' for headings.

colors.descriptions: Dark theme with specific base #0a0a20 (background) and #16162a (card) matching the client requirements, with vivid orange #f97316 as the primary accent color.

visual_enhancers.borders: Use subtle borders 'border-border' which is mapped to #2a2a40 to separate sections without harsh lines.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Deep ambient shadows like 'shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)]' for dropdowns or modals over the dark background. Inner shadows on inputs can give a tactile feel.
visual_enhancers.textures: Background sections should be solid #0a0a20 with #16162a floating cards to maintain a clinical, professional dashboard feel.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid borders or subtle rounded cards (max 8px radius) for the profile management layout. No transparent dropdowns. Use solid dark colors to prevent text collision.

layouts.app_structure: Dashboard-style side navigation or top navigation with a main content area. Wide max-w-7xl containers for profile forms to ensure high density and clarity.
layouts.profile_editor: Bento grid or multi-column layout for profile settings. 1 column on mobile, 2 or 3 columns on desktop. Inputs should be well-spaced (gap-6) and strictly left-aligned.
layouts.media_gallery: Masonry or responsive grid layout (grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-5) with gap-4 for images. Upload section should have dashed borders and clear orange CTA.
layouts.account_settings: Vertical forms with clear spacing (gap-6) and distinct action buttons. Verification code input should use a flex layout with gap-2 or specialized OTP component.

components.buttons: Rounded-md buttons with clear focus states (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:outline-none). Primary buttons use bg-primary hover:bg-orange-600 transition-colors.
components.inputs: Solid dark inputs bg-background border-border text-foreground rounded-md, with focus ring orange (focus:border-primary). Left-aligned labels above inputs.
components.cards: bg-card border border-border shadow-sm rounded-lg. Padding should be generous (p-6 or p-8) to give content breathing room.
components.upload_zone: Dashed border-border bg-card/50 hover:bg-card hover:border-primary transition-all p-8 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center cursor-pointer min-h-[200px] rounded-lg.
components.gallery_item: Relative positioning group. Image inside rounded-md with object-cover. Hover state shows dark overlay (bg-black/60) with 'delete' (წაშლა) icon button in the corner.

motion.hover: Hovering interactive elements should shift background colors slightly (e.g., from orange-500 to orange-600) and scale up slightly without aggressive bounce.
motion.upload_progress: Smooth width transition on the progress bar (transition-all duration-300 ease-out) styled with the primary orange.
motion.toast: Use sonner for toast notifications on save/success sliding in smoothly from the bottom right.

accessibility.focus: All form inputs and buttons must have focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:outline-none.
accessibility.contrast: Text over background must maintain a high contrast ratio. Gray-400 for secondary text and Gray-100 for primary text.
accessibility.aria: Use aria-labels for icon buttons (like image deletion) and inputs.

instructions_to_main_agent: Force dark mode by replacing the :root and .dark variables in index.css with the ones provided in css_variables_update.
Apply the requested background colors #0a0a20 (background) and #16162a (card) effectively. Do not use generic full-screen gradients.
Use 'Noto Sans Georgian' for Georgian text display and set it in the font-family of the body.
Ensure the UI language is Georgian: 'რეგისტრაცია' (Registration), 'ავტორიზაცია' (Login), 'პროფილი' (Profile), 'გალერეა' (Gallery), 'პარამეტრები' (Settings), 'შენახვა' (Save).
Implement the 'upload progress' in the media gallery visually using a mock progress bar or a Shadcn Progress component.
Implement data-testid attributes on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and subtle shadows, even on dark themes.
NEVER use fully transparent backgrounds for components like dropdowns, modals, or sticky headers. Ensure content beneath them does not bleed through.
NEVER use generic centered layouts for dashboards. Left-align text inputs and forms. Center-align only for landing heroes or specific artistic choices.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
Do not use transition: all globally. Use targeted transitions like transition-colors or transition-transform.
